description: Implement GitHub PR management in GCT API: POST /api/v1/repo/pr/create, GET /api/v1/repo/pr/list, GET /api/v1/repo/pr/{number}, POST /api/v1/repo/pr/{number}/merge. GitHub client behind interface with real and mock implementations. All tests use mock — zero real GitHub API calls. Auto-populate PR description from commit analysis. Reuse existing credential storage for GitHub token management.
name: gct-github-pr-api
title: PR create/list/view/merge endpoints with mocked test suite
